info.name: HashiCorp Vault KV Secrets Engine Auth Methods API

items.docs: List all currently enabled authentication methods. Returns configuration details for each auth method including type, description, and tuning settings.

params.name: path
params.description: Mount path for the auth method or secrets engine. Must not contain slashes at the beginning or end.

items.docs: Enable a new auth method at the specified path. Requires sudo capability. Supported types include approle, aws, azure, github, jwt, kubernetes, ldap, oidc, okta, radius, token, and userpass.

params.name: path
params.description: Mount path for the auth method or secrets engine. Must not contain slashes at the beginning or end.

items.docs: Disable the auth method at the specified path. Any tokens associated with this auth method will be revoked. Requires sudo capability.
